as_told.title: Rumours that Hughes's Glomar Explorer recovered objects from the seafloor

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, wonders aloud whether the Glomar Explorer, a big ship working in the Pacific Ocean around 1974 and tied to a huge corporation, might have served a second, hidden purpose. He raises it in a talk about unexplained things in the ocean, hinting that the ship's work might have touched on that subject too.
